import urllib.request, json
isbn = '9784873767369'
print('--- NDL ---')
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request(f'https://ndlsearch.ndl.go.jp/api/sru?operation=searchRetrieve&recordPacking=xml&query=isbn={isbn}')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        print(response.read().decode()[:500])
except Exception as e:
    print('NDL Error:', e)

    req = urllib.request.Request(f'https://app.rakuten.co.jp/services/api/BooksBook/Search/20170404?format=json&isbn={isbn}&applicationId={app_id}')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
        if data and 'Items' in data and len(data['Items']) > 0:
            print('salesDate:', data['Items'][0]['Item'].get('salesDate'))
except Exception as e:
